reader_summary.overview: This is Dom Cooke and this week is a little different. It’s Super Bowl week and to get in the mood. We have covered each of these sports over the past two years on Business Breakdowns. But for this episode, we have condensed those conversations into 100 minutes of action, focusing on the similarities and differences between these major leagues.

key_points.text: It’s Super Bowl week and to get in the mood.
In terms of revenue, the NFL dwarfs the other two sports.
But in terms of eyeballs, Formula 1 is the clear global leader.
